_why: Frozen strategy parameters. signal_dual_momentum.py refuses to emit ledger records when its effective parameters do not match this file. The point is not to make change impossible -- it is to make change impossible to do QUIETLY. Editing this file shows up in a git diff with a human name on it; re-fitting after a losing quarter does not get to look like a normal run. See reference/STRATEGY.md: parameters are not to be re-fit on the realised sample, because that is how a dead strategy becomes an overfitted one.
_reason: Pre-registered before the strategy has seen a single live signal. No results existed to tune toward, which is the only honest moment to fix parameters.
